verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a managed SaaS service like Amazon IVS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes an in-product assistant that can take delegated tasks. The AWS-wide llms.txt file is documentation access for external LLMs, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
